purpose: A1362 (Marcel W1600): window frame, button, bar and speech bubble in the warm comic style of the game (reference D355), three candidate looks for Marcel's choice; the chosen look is then cut into 9-slice graphics.
template: A single empty {element} for a calm, friendly video game user interface, flat front view, perfectly centered on a plain light grey background, symmetrical. {style} Empty inside: no text, no letters, no numbers, no icons, no people.

elements.text: rectangular window panel with a decorative frame and rounded corners
long horizontal toolbar strip with rounded ends
long horizontal header strip with rounded ends
small rectangular note card with rounded corners
rounded rectangle speech bubble body without a tail
single small triangular speech-bubble tail pointing down

variants.style: Comic illustration of a frame made of smooth driftwood planks with a bold ink outline, warm sand-coloured fill, painted with warm saturated colours.

changes: Marcel chose B driftwood (F5251). v2 adds the parts GW3 needs (AMW #18641): header strip, tooltip card and a separate speech-bubble tail; rounded-rectangle bubble instead of an oval (9-slice).
